description:
Hi everyone! Myself Aiswarya Ranjith. I'm a passionate and enthusiastic student interested in technology, innovation and exploring new ideas.

I enjoy learning new things, working with a team and finding creative solutions to real-world problems. I'm particularly interested in exploring how technology can be used to make a positive impact.

Being part of the NASA Space Apps Challenge is a great opportunity for me to improve my skills, gain experience and collaborate with like-minded people.
